title: Notion Toggles to Flashcards config schema
description: Configuration of the Notion Toggles to Flashcards Anki add-on.

recursive.title: Recursive export
recursive.description: Page should be exported with all its subpages.

target_deck.title: Target deck
target_deck.description: The target deck is a string attribute that specifies the name of the deck where loaded notes will be added. Use '::' to create subdecks (e.g. 'Languages::English'). An existing deck is found by its last name part wherever it is, so a moved deck keeps being used; if several decks share the name you are asked once which one. If multiple page_ids refer to the same target_deck, their corresponding notes will be combined and added to the same target_deck.

subdecks.title: Subpages as subdecks
subdecks.description: With recursive: put each subpage's notes into a subdeck named after it (e.g. 'AWS::IAM'). Existing cards are moved, keeping their history.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.description: Enable debug logging. Log can be found unfer plugin directory.

sync_every_minutes.title: Synchronization interval in minutes
sync_every_minutes.description: Synchronization interval in minutes. Set to 0 to disable autosync

sequential_sync.title: Sequential sync mode
sequential_sync.description: Export pages one at a time instead of all at once. Only needed if you still hit Notion rate limits.

worker_stagger_delay.title: Worker stagger delay (seconds)
worker_stagger_delay.description: Seconds to wait between starting page exports. Set to 0 for no delay.

skip_unchanged_pages.title: Skip unchanged pages
skip_unchanged_pages.description: Background syncs skip non-recursive pages whose last-edited time has not changed since the last successful sync. Manual syncs always export everything.

remove_mode.title: What 'remove deleted notes' does
remove_mode.description: 'suspend' (default): suspend the cards and tag them notion-deleted, nothing is lost. 'delete': delete the notes and their review history.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone used by Notion when rendering dates in exports (e.g. 'Europe/London'). Empty means the computer's time zone.

file_token.title: Notion file token
file_token.description: Token for downloading files from file.notion.com. Get it from browser cookies (DevTools > Application > Cookies > file.notion.com > file_token).

notion_namespace.title: Notion namespace
notion_namespace.description: Notion namespace (your username) to form source URLs.

notion_pages.title: Notion pages to export
notion_pages.description: List of Notion pages to export notes from.
